pairs.question: Paano kinokwenta ang electrical inspection fee base sa Total Connected Load (kVA) ng isang commercial establishment?
pairs.category: Office of the City Building Official

common_sources.document: OCBD Pages from CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf

responses.text:
The electrical inspection fee for a commercial establishment is computed based on the Total Connected Load (kVA). The following schedule is used for the computation:

- For Total Connected Load of 5 kVA or less, the fee is P 200.00.
- For Total Connected Load over 5 kVA to 50 kVA, the fee is P 200.00 plus P 20.00 for each kVA.
- For Total Connected Load over 50 kVA to 300 kVA, the fee is P 1,100.00 plus P 10.00 for each kVA.

This information can be found in [S1] under Section 4.e Electrical Fees.

pairs.question: Ano ang mga kailangan para makakuha ng Occupational Permit ang mga regular na empleyado at dayuhang manggagawa?

responses.text:
Ang mga kailangan para makakuha ng Occupational Permit ng mga regular na empleyado at dayuhang manggagawa ay nababasa sa Citizens' Charter ng Business Bureau sa pages 104 at 106 ng CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf.

Para sa mga Pilipino na empleyado o manggagawa, ang kailangan ay:
- Application Form (makukuha sa Business Bureau Office) [S2, S3]
- Professional Tax Receipt kung mayroon (hindi na kailangan kung mayroon na ang isang valid na Professional Tax Receipt) [S1]

Para sa mga dayuhang manggagawa, ang kailangan ay:
- Alien Employment Permit mula sa Department of Labor and Employment (kung mayroon) [S2]
- Affidavit of Consent kung mayroon pa man nakakapagtrabaho ang isang kabataan na hindi pa 18 years old (kung mayroon na nakakapagtrabaho ang isang kabataan na mayroon na raw ang kapangyarihan na makapagtrabaho) [S2]

Ang Occupational Permit ay renewed annually on or before January 31. Mayroon din pang penalty ng 25% kung hindi ito renewed late. [S1]

Ang Occupational Permit ay maaaring makukuha sa website https://occupationalpermit.davaocity.gov.ph/ o sa kopya na maaaring ipadala sa e-mail o SMS para sa mga online applicants. Para sa mga walk-in applicants, maaaring kumuha ng hard copy ng Occupational Permit sa Office ng City Mayor's Office – Permits & Licenses Division. [S3]

To obtain an Occupational Permit as a regular employee or a foreign worker, the following requirements are needed based on [S2] and [S3] from the Business Bureau's Citizens Charter 2026:

1. Submit an application for the Occupational Permit.

3. Pay the corresponding fee:
   - Php125 for new and renewal applications
   - Php156.25 for late renewal applications

The processing time for both online and onsite applications is approximately 14 minutes, while the total time to complete the process is around 33 minutes. If the application is denied, the applicant will receive the returned documents and may need to reapply.

2. After the initial steps, the Zoning Officer IV re-evaluates the documents and prepares the Zoning Certification [S1]. This process takes about 5 hours.

3. The Zoning Officer IV then signs the certification (initial and final) [S1]. This step may take 2 days depending on the availability of the Zoning Administrator or Acting Zoning Administrator.

4. If the application is approved, the documents will be released to the client [S3]. If the application is denied or requires conditional approval, the client will be advised accordingly [S3].

5. If the application is denied, the client may appeal through the Local Zoning Board of Adjustments and Appeals [S3].

pairs.question: Unsa ang mga rekisitos para sa Occupational Permit sa mga ordinaryong trabahante ug langyaw nga trabahante?

responses.text:
Sa mga ordinaryong trabahante ug langyaw nga trabahante, ang mga rekisitos para sa Occupational Permit sa Davao City ay nakatanggap sa Business Bureau's Citizen Charter 2026. Ang mga rekisito sa Occupational Permit ay nakalistado sa mga chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0067-C001 at DEV120-BB-PDF0067-C002 sa pagkakabuo ng mga chunk 3 sa pag. 106 ng Citizen Charter.

Ang mga rekisito sa Occupational Permit sa mga ordinaryong trabahante ay:

1. [S1] - Mag-submit ng application form para sa Occupational Permit.
2. [S1] - Mag-present ng mga nakakatugon na dokumento sa application form, kabilang ang:
   - Proof of Business Name Registration (for self-employed individuals)
   - Proof of Employment (for employees)
   - Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
   - Barangay Clearance
   - Police Clearance
   - Birth Certificate
   - Marriage Certificate (kung may kasama ang asawa)
   - Photocopy ng Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) ID (kung mayroon)
   - Photocopy ng Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) ID (kung mayroon)
   - Photocopy ng Business Permit (kung mayroon)
   - Photocopy ng Tax Identification Number (TIN)

3. [S2] - Magbayad ng fee:
   - Php125 para sa new at updated renewal
   - Php156.25 para sa late renewal

4. [S3] - Mag-submit ng hard copy ng Occupational Permit sa Business Bureau kung walk-in applicant (kung mayroon) o mag-download ang online applicant ang Occupational Permit sa website https://occupationalpermit.davaocity.gov.ph/ o sa link na ipinadala sa e-mail o SMS.

2. If the Total Connected Load is over 5 kVA to 50 kVA, the fee is P 200.00 + P 20.00/kVA [S1].
3. If the Total Connected Load is over 50 kVA to 300 kVA, the fee is 1,100.00 + 10.00/kVA [S1, S2].
4. If the Total Connected Load is over 300 kVA, the fee is not specified in the provided sources. However, for loads over 300 kVA to 1,500 kVA, the fee is 3,600.00 + 5.00/kVA, and for loads over 1,500 kVA to 6,000 kVA, the fee is 9,600.00 + 2.50/kVA. For loads over 6,000 kVA, the fee is 20,850.00 + 1.25/kVA [S2].

Please note that the Total Connected Load as shown in the load schedule should be used for the calculations [S1, S2].

responses.text:
Sa CPDO (City Planning and Development Office), ang pagpangayo ug opisyal na dokumento sa zoning o land use ay ma-evaluate sa proposed land use activity at land classification. Ang mga proseso nga nakatabang sa pag-apply sa zoning o land use ay nakalistado sa Citizen's Charter 2026 ng CPDO sa mga chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0067-C002 at DEV120-CPDO-PDF0068-C001.

Ang mga proseso nga nakalistado sa Citizen's Charter sa CPDO sa pag-apply sa zoning o land use sa ilang detalye:

1. Zone Regulations ([S2] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0067-C002)
   - Classification: Simple Transaction
   - Timeframe: 10 minutes
   - Responsible Office: Zoning Officer, IV, CPDO
   - Description: Ang mga applications are evaluated based on the proposed land use activity and its land classification.

2. Consultation with the ZED Division Chief and Acting Zoning Administration ([S2] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0067-C002)
   - Classification: Simple Transaction
   - Timeframe: 10 minutes
   - Responsible Office: Acting Zoning Administrator, CPDO
   - Description: Makes positive recommendation and updates the BPLS system.

3. Routes documents to ZED receiving/releasing personnel and updates document tracking system ([S3] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0068-C001)
   - Classification: Simple Transaction
   - Timeframe: 5 minutes
   - Responsible Office: Zoning Officer, IV, CPDO
   - Description: Routes documents to ZED receiving/releasing personnel and updates document tracking system.

4. Claims application documents ([S3] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0068-C001)
   - Classification: Simple Transaction
   - Timeframe: Not specified
   - Responsible Office: Zoning Officer, IV, CPDO
   - Description: Claims application documents.

5. Releases documents to client/s ([S3] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0068-C001)
   - Classification: Simple Transaction
   - Timeframe: Not specified
   - Responsible Office: Zoning Officer, IV, CPDO
   - Description: Releases documents to client/s.

Sa ilang mga detalye, ang mga non-compliant applications ma-deny ang client, at ang mga denied applications mao nga mao nga ma-advise nga mag-appeal sa Local Zoning Board of Adjustments and Appeals ([S2] chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0068-C001). pairs.question: Paano kinokwenta ang bayad sa Demolition Permit kada metro kwadrado ng floor area at taas ng gusali?

Ang bayad sa Demolition Permit ay kinokwenta sa National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) na nakatanggap ng bagong Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR). Sa ilalim ng mga ito, ang bayad ay kinokwenta per square meter ng floor area ng bawat gusali ([S3]).

Para sa mga bawat metro kwadrado ng floor area, ang bayad ay Php 3.00 ([S3]).

Para sa mga structures na may taas ng 10.00 meters o mas mataas, ang bayad ay kinokwenta every meter o portion thereof ([S3]).

Wala pong nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa bayad para sa mga gusali na may floor area above 10,000.00 sq.meters.

Sa iba pang mga transaksyon, maaari mong dahan-dahan pansinin ang Citizens' Charter ng BFP ([S1]) at ng Office of the City/Municipal Building Official (OCBO) ([S2]).
